programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues with Brittany who says dad Charlie is being scammed by his online fiancée "Stephanie" & her roommate "Carina." Charlie hopes to get married when they meet in person. The real women in the photos are on stage & Charlie goes face-to-face!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: There have been no answers to the whereabouts of Summer Wells, 5, missing since 2021. Parents Don & Candus say it backfired by requesting the public's help. In this exclusive first national TV interview, Dr. Phil digs deeper into the story.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A father pleads for help regarding his missing daughter. Gabby Petito, 22, set off on a van trip with her fiancé, but two months later he returned alone. Police revealed the couple had an incident--caught on camera. Gabby's dad is determined to find her.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do "van life" blogger Gabby Petito's videos reveal what might have happened? TV host Nancy Grace, a former law enforcement officer & FBI defense tactics instructor, a criminal defense attorney & a body language expert all weigh in on the unusual details.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After another mass shooting in America, the elementary school in Uvalde, Texas where 2 teachers and 19 children were killed, Dr. Phil dedicates the show to speaking out about how these senseless acts of murder need to end and the importantance of change.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What makes a good wife? Is it cooking, cleaning, raising the kids and having great sex? Dr. Phil says too few couples understand what it means to be a "Mrs." He delves into the role of the wife in 2005.

programme.title: Lost Over Burma Search For Closure
programme.desc: During the final days of the Second World War, an RCAF crew of six young Canadians sets out on a routine mission, dropping food and supplies for isolated Burmese villages. Their Dakota cargo plane takes off over the jungle--and vanishes without a trace.

programme.title: This Borrowed Land
programme.desc: "This Borrowed Land" highlights women farmers in BC's Peace River Valley, protesting hydro dam construction threatening their farmland. They question land use, food production, and their children's future in a film on agriculture, ecology, and resilience.

programme.title: Goddess Remembered
programme.desc: This poetic documentary is a salute to 35 000 years of "pre-history," to the values of ancestors only recently remembered, and to the goddess-worshipping religions of the ancient past.

programme.title: Physics Of Sorrow, The
programme.desc: The Physics of Sorrow tracks an unknown man’s life as he sifts through memories of his youth in Bulgaria through to his increasingly rootless and melancholic adulthood in Canada.

programme.title: Special Delivery
programme.desc: The first big mistake Ralph makes is not clearing the snow from the front walk, and his life goes downhill from that point on. By the end of the story, the mailman has fatally slipped on his job, and Alice, his wife, doesn't live there anymore.

programme.title: A Mother And Daughter On Abortion
programme.desc: The document of an intimate conversation between a mother and her adult daughter. They speak candidly about their personal experiences in trying to obtain an abortion, and how, in different decade, each got caught up in the system and its rules.

programme.title: The Glass Ceiling
programme.desc: Whether in the public service or on the shop floor, discrimination against women is taking on increasingly subtle forms, which makes it even more difficult to eliminate.

programme.title: I Want To Be An Engineer
programme.desc: This film provides a lively introduction to the professional and personal lives of three female engineers--just a few of the growing number of women who are opting for "non-traditional" jobs.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: In the third round of qualifying, ninjas including Jessie Graff, Najee Richardson, Michelle Warnky and Adam Rayl face up to six challenging obstacles, including the high-flying Beehive, which is new to the course this year.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: In the final round of qualifying, ninjas including Meagan Martin, Joe Moravsky, Tiana Webberley, Michael Torres and the Cowboy Ninja Lance Pekus face up to six challenging obstacles, including Off the Hook, Spinning Bridge and the new Sideways.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: In the first round of the semifinals, competitors including Daniel Gil, Jesse Labreck, Sandy Zimmerman, Jody Avila and Grant McCartney face up to 10 daunting obstacles, including Clockwork and the new head-spinning Corkscrew.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: In round two of the semifinals, competitors including Jessie Graff, Najee Richardson, Joe Moravsky and Meagan Martin face up to 10 brutal obstacles, including the dizzying Corkscrew, the Salmon Ladder and the Dungeon.

programme.title: Bloomberg Open Interest
programme.desc: Delivering the market-moving news anyone needs to know to get a jump start on the U.S. trading day.

programme.title: Bloomberg Technology
programme.desc: The only daily news program focused exclusively on technology, innovation and the future of business hosted by Ed Ludlow from San Francisco and Caroline Hyde in New York.

programme.desc: The most important global business and breaking markets news and information as it happens.

programme.title: Bloomberg: Balance of Power

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'affrontement, 1ère partie

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'affrontement, 2e partie

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mutation accidentelle

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Qui est le chef ?

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion des écureuils-mutants

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mutagène-man se déchaîne

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'acné mutante de Mikey

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Une cible nommée April O'Neil
